source: Visit KC (visitkc.com) listings and guides (streetcar dining guide, lunch spots, cocktail bars) and OpenTable's Crossroads romantic-restaurant rankings, checked Nov 2026.

spots.name: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
spots.blurb: Encyclopedic art museum with the giant Shuttlecocks sculptures on its lawn; general admission is free. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte enciclopédico con las enormes esculturas Shuttlecocks en su jardín; la entrada general es gratuita. Cierra martes y miércoles.

spots.name: National WWI Museum and Memorial
spots.blurb: The nation's museum of the First World War, topped by the Liberty Memorial tower with views over downtown. Closed Tuesdays.
spots.blurbEs: El museo nacional de la Primera Guerra Mundial, coronado por la torre Liberty Memorial con vistas al centro. Cierra los martes.

spots.name: Science City at Union Station
spots.blurb: Hands-on science center spread over 92,000 square feet inside the restored 1914 Union Station.
spots.blurbEs: Centro de ciencias interactivo de más de 92,000 pies cuadrados dentro de la histórica Union Station de 1914.

spots.name: LEGOLAND Discovery Center Kansas City
spots.blurb: Indoor LEGO play center at Crown Center with build zones and rides for younger kids; toddlers 2 and under are free.
spots.blurbEs: Centro de juegos LEGO bajo techo en Crown Center, con zonas para construir y atracciones para niños pequeños; menores de 2 años entran gratis.

spots.name: American Jazz Museum
spots.blurb: Museum of jazz history in the 18th & Vine district, sharing a building with the Negro Leagues Baseball Museum.
spots.blurbEs: Museo de la historia del jazz en el distrito 18th & Vine, en el mismo edificio que el Negro Leagues Baseball Museum.

spots.name: Country Club Plaza
spots.blurb: Spanish-style shopping district whose holiday lights outline its shops, domes and towers from Thanksgiving to mid-January.
spots.blurbEs: Distrito comercial de estilo español cuyas luces navideñas delinean tiendas, cúpulas y torres desde Acción de Gracias hasta mediados de enero.
